mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects ( pattern_id, size, status, pattern_gauge_stitch_count, pattern_gauge_row_count, pattern_gauge_width_cm, pattern_gauge_height_cm, start_date, completed_date, current_page, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{patternId}, #{size}, #{status}, #{patternGaugeStitchCount}, #{patternGaugeRowCount}, #{patternGaugeWidthCm}, #{patternGaugeHeightCm}, #{startDate}, #{completedDate}, #{currentPage}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.pattern_id AS patternId, pt.pattern_name AS patternName, pt.thumbnail_path AS thumbnailPath, p.size, p.status, p.current_page AS currentPage, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN patterns pt ON p.pattern_id = pt.pattern_id
WHERE pt.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.pattern_id AS patternId,
pt.pattern_name AS patternName, pt.thumbnail_path AS thumbnailPath,
p.size, p.status,
p.pattern_gauge_stitch_count AS patternGaugeStitchCount, p.pattern_gauge_row_count AS patternGaugeRowCount, p.pattern_gauge_width_cm AS patternGaugeWidthCm, p.pattern_gauge_height_cm AS patternGaugeHeightCm,
p.start_date AS startDate, p.completed_date AS completedDate, p.current_page AS currentPage,
p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN patterns pt ON p.pattern_id = pt.pattern_id
WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND pt.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update:
UPDATE projects p
INNER JOIN patterns pt ON p.pattern_id = pt.pattern_id
SET p.size = COALESCE(#{request.size}, p.size),
p.pattern_gauge_stitch_count = COALESCE( #{request.patternGaugeStitchCount}, p.pattern_gauge_stitch_count ),
p.pattern_gauge_row_count = COALESCE( #{request.patternGaugeRowCount}, p.pattern_gauge_row_count ),
p.pattern_gauge_width_cm = COALESCE( #{request.patternGaugeWidthCm}, p.pattern_gauge_width_cm ),
p.pattern_gauge_height_cm = COALESCE( #{request.patternGaugeHeightCm}, p.pattern_gauge_height_cm ),
p.updated_at = NOW()
WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND pt.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE projects p
INNER JOIN patterns pt ON p.pattern_id = pt.pattern_id
SET p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS', p.start_date = CURDATE(), p.updated_at = NOW()
WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND pt.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PREPARING'
